title: Do not bow to borrowed authority
summary: The shabad refuses reverence for a teacher whose status depends on begging and display. Let discernment look for honest work before it bows.
takeaway: Do not hand your reverence to a title without truth.
lifeApplication: Before you follow a voice today, look for humility, honest labor, and generosity in what it asks of you.

source.shortMeaning: A claimed guide who lives by borrowed authority should not receive the devotion due to truth.
source.lifeApplication: Pause before giving trust to spiritual display; let the fruit of a life, not the costume of a role, teach you where to bow.

evidence.coreClaim: A claimed guide who lives by borrowed authority should not receive the devotion due to truth.
evidence.turn: The line trains discernment to test authority by integrity rather than by title.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before you follow a voice today, look for humility, honest labor, and generosity in what it asks of you.
